2026_03_NE_JAX.headline: New England and Jacksonville meet in a quarterback test shaped by pressure and explosives
2026_03_NE_JAX.paragraph1: New England and Jacksonville both need their quarterbacks to avoid the mistakes that turn competitive possessions into short fields. The Patriots can help themselves with a balanced early-down approach and protection that keeps deeper concepts available. Jacksonville’s offense has enough speed to threaten vertically, but the Jaguars must keep pressure from disrupting timing. Defensively, both teams should prioritize limiting explosive plays and forcing the opponent to string together long drives without a sack, penalty or turnover.
2026_03_NE_JAX.model_rationale: This matchup rewards the offense that protects its quarterback and limits negative plays, because both sides become easier to defend when forced into predictable passing situations.
